abilities.effect: Stops, raises the camera and flashes: every plant inside a 5 m, 35 deg half-angle frontal cone is stunned for 2 s (no targeting, firing, detonating or producing). Repeats every 6 s; when no plant is in the cone she re-checks every 0.5 s and does not flash.
abilities.name: Say Cheese!
abilities.trigger: Flash timer ready and at least one plant in the cone (TouristZombie.gd); first flash after 3 s

abilities.effect: 8 damage per camera bonk every 0.5 s (2 bonks per 1.0 s loop).
abilities.name: Camera Bonk

abilities.effect: 6 damage per hit every 1.0 s (1 hit per loop).
abilities.name: Siege
abilities.trigger: Within 1.3 m of the dais wall (inherited)

clipAnnotations.attack: 1.0 s loop at native 1.0x speed: 2 bonks (camera swung overhead, down onto the plant at 0.25 s and 0.75 s); 1 plant bite per 0.5 s beat, 1 house hit per loop.
clipAnnotations.die: One-shot 1.8 s: a weak fizzling flash, the non la flies off, she sits down and shrinks away; then freed.
clipAnnotations.flash: One-shot 1.1 s: raises the camera to eye level (0-0.35 s), holds, FLASH at 0.5 s (emissive burst 0.45-0.7 s, recoil), lowers by 1.1 s. The enemy holds still for the whole clip; the stun lands at flash_apex_sec.
clipAnnotations.walk: 1.2 s loop at native 1.0x: sightseeing amble, head turning side to side, camera bobbing on its strap, ao dai panels fluttering.

lore: Her camera flash dazzles plants and leaves them blind for a moment.
mechanism: Disabler: a fragile, slow Hungry Ghost (70 HP, 0.6 m/s). A flash timer counts down (flash_first_delay, then flash_interval); when it is ready and at least one plant is inside the frontal cone (flash_range, flash_half_angle_deg; squared-dot test, cos and range squared precomputed) she holds still for the flash clip and at flash_apex_sec calls PlantBase.stun(stun_duration) on every plant still in the cone. With no plant in the cone she re-checks every flash_retry_interval. Stunned plants skip their acting loop (CONTRACT(plant-stun)). Bites 8 per 0.5 s, siege 6 per 1.0 s. All march/seek/eat/siege AI, health bar and materials inherited.
name: Tourist Zombie
